description: A card that waits for the owner, whole, as the owner sees it before answering: its words, who made it, what making it cost in tokens (the ledger's own count on the rows its work logged, or a note that none was recorded), its options, everything it carries (a post's or a reply's draft, the thread a reply answers, a message's words with its writer and the post it is under, an audit's fixes in full, emails, money), the records behind it, each page version it asks to publish read as text (titles, headings, words, links, buttons), and every picture's address. With pictures: true, Marsell's own pictures come as images too. Leave card_id out for every waiting card. Reads only: answering is answer_decision.

card_id.description: The card's id, as list_decisions or get_overview give it. Every waiting card when left out.

pictures.description: true to get the pictures themselves as images beside the answer (Marsell's own pictures); otherwise their addresses, which you can open.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: card_read
title: Read a card whole
